object.description: Setup: fresh install, no permissions granted; run once on an Android 13 or later device and once on an Android 9 device. Steps: 1. Select Start. 2. Note each permission prompt. 3. Deny location. Expected: The prompts cover location on both devices, notifications on the Android 13 device only and activity recognition on the Android 10 or later device only; after denial the Home screen remains, no session exists and no session notification is shown.
